Name: Mina Han - A Fresh Start
Author: Lolsnaps
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1790536021-1996085881.png[/img]
[b]Mina Han is Lewis’s niece. She’s quit her office job at Joja and moved into his guest annex in Pelican Town.[/b]

You’ve both left Joja, but she doesn’t see your situations as equal. You inherited a farm. She’s staying with her uncle and struggling with work everyone else seems to manage. She gets defensive when you offer help, and she doesn’t hide her jealousy well.

Includes 20 story and relationship scenes, a full friendship route, optional romance and marriage, seasonal outfits, daily routines and three original songs.

[quote][b]Content note:[/b] Burnout, insecurity, jealousy, a hurtful confrontation and strong language. Details of the story’s consequences are hidden in the event spoilers below.[/quote][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1790535741-770256862.png[/img]
[b]Birthday:[/b] Fall 13 · [b]Home:[/b] the guest annex inside Lewis’s manor
[b]Arrival:[/b] Summer 2, Year 1. Add the mod after that date on an existing save and she arrives the next morning. 

Haley becomes a close friend. Gus gives Mina a chance to learn the work at the Saloon, while Lewis keeps trying to help in ways she... doesn’t always appreciate. She also spends time with Emily, Caroline and other villagers.

Her progress at work evolves as she learns how to adjust to her new life, and she takes on more responsibility as she spends time in town.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1790535727-1679596687.png[/img]
Her room has a low tea table, a patchwork wall hanging and a few family keepsakes. The design is cozy modern Korean, with the same influence in her spouse room. After marriage, she also has an herb patio.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1791061393-719242831.png[/img]
[line]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1790535783-196069072.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1791061380-1900226073.png[/img]

Mina has seasonal clothes and small changes to her hair accessories which follow the seasons. She changes into home clothes in her room, an apron for paid work, and an umbrella or poncho when it rains. There are also outfits for the Ginger Island, dates, and the wedding.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1790541711-644501813.png[/img]
You’ll see her eat, drink, read and work as she goes about her day. Rainwear stays outside, and the apron comes off for her breaks.
[line]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1790535899-1240612130.png[/img]
Mina visits the library, shops, beach and river, and spends evenings at the Saloon. She talks with nearby villagers, attends festivals after her arrival, and can visit the cinema and island resort once they’re available.

After seven days in town, she starts observing Gus at work. At fourteen days she takes on small paid tasks; after twenty-eight, she has limited Wednesday and Friday shifts.

In winter, the beach and outdoor photo visits move indoors. Early Wednesday and Friday routines also differ while she is still learning the work.[/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1790536068-1974986826.png[/img]

[b]Likes:[/b] Coffee, Honey, Tulip, Sunflower, Salad, Vegetable Medley.

[b]Dislikes:[/b] Clay and the fish/shellfish listed below.
Pufferfish, Anchovy, Tuna, Sardine, Bream, Largemouth Bass, Smallmouth Bass, Rainbow Trout, Salmon, Walleye, Perch, Carp, Catfish, Pike, Sunfish, Red Mullet, Herring, Eel, Octopus, Red Snapper, Squid, Sea Cucumber, Super Cucumber, Ghostfish, Stonefish, Crimsonfish, Angler, Ice Pip, Lava Eel, Legend, Sandfish, Scorpion Carp, Clam, Mutant Carp, Sturgeon, Tiger Trout, Bullhead, Tilapia, Chub, Dorado, Albacore, Shad, Lingcod, Halibut, Lobster, Crayfish, Crab, Cockle, Mussel, Shrimp, Snail, Periwinkle, Oyster, Woodskip, Glacierfish, Void Salmon, Slimejack, Midnight Squid, Spook Fish, Blobfish, Flounder, Midnight Carp, Stingray, Lionfish, Blue Discus, Son of Crimsonfish, Ms. Angler, Legend II, Radioactive Carp, Glacierfish Jr., Goby.[/spoiler]
[line]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1790536147-1129418275.png[/img]
[b]Romance is optional.[/b]

Staying friends gives you two later friendship scenes. Declining her invitation or asking for time doesn’t cost friendship points.
Once you’ve rebuilt your friendship and reached eight hearts, Mina may do the asking... But you can also give her a bouquet yourself.
[spoiler]Her default wait is fifteen eligible days while you’re both available and romance remains open.[/spoiler]
Marriage uses the game’s wedding and household systems, with Mina’s own spouse room, routines, dialogue and later scenes.

[b]Mina's Marriage Room Addon:[/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1791061414-1993264591.png[/img]

[b]Story spoilers — the argument and rebuilding[/b]

[spoiler]At six hearts, after the earlier friendship scenes, Mina’s frustration turns into a long, hurtful argument. Three attacks on the farmer accompany visible heart shatters, ending at three hearts. The scene has its own rain, thunder, music and expressions.

The loss happens once. Skipping the scene gives a written account and the same outcome. Two days later, speak to her for the separate apology; it remains available even at zero hearts. If you ask for space, you choose when to resume contact. Rebuild to four and then six hearts to continue.[/spoiler]

[b]The complete event guide below lists all twenty scenes, their conditions and where to find them.[/b]

[spoiler][b]Major spoilers for Mina’s friendship, romance and marriage story.[/b]

Visit the listed location during these hours once you meet the requirements. Only one Mina story scene starts per day. Festivals, weddings and other events can postpone it. Some scenes require you to speak to her; if you asked for space, resume contact when you’re ready. Her reminder letters can help you find a waiting scene.

[b]One Suitcase[/b]
After arrival.
Town in dry weather, or Lewis’s manor. 9 am–7 pm.

[b]A Very Small Disaster[/b]
2 hearts; finish One Suitcase.
Town in dry weather, or her annex. 10 am–5 pm.

[b]A Place in the Picture[/b]
4 hearts; finish A Very Small Disaster.
Town in dry weather, 10 am–10 pm. An indoor Saloon alternative opens after three days of waiting.

[b]Useful on Paper[/b]
5 hearts; finish A Place in the Picture.
Saloon, 10 am–10 pm.

[b]Handed Everything[/b]
6 hearts; finish Useful on Paper; not dating, engaged or married to Mina. Friendship ends at 3 hearts once.
Town, 4–8 pm. The scene supplies its own storm; you do not need to wait for a rainy forecast.

[b]No Excuse Attached[/b]
At least two days after the argument. Speak to Mina; no minimum hearts.
Town or Saloon, 10 am–10 pm.

[b]The Second Bowl[/b]
Rebuild to 4 hearts after the apology. If you asked for space, resume contact first.
Saloon, 10 am–10 pm.

[b]A Fair Day's Work[/b]
Rebuild to 6 hearts after The Second Bowl.
Saloon, 10 am–10 pm.

[b]Room at the Table[/b]
8 hearts after A Fair Day’s Work.
Saloon or her annex, 6–9 pm.

[b]The Picture We Keep[/b]
Finish Room at the Table, then choose friendship or have new romance disabled while not dating/engaged/married. A later day.
Town in dry weather, 11 am–6 pm. Saloon alternative after three days of waiting.

[b]I Was Going to Ask[/b]
After rebuilding, hold at least 8 hearts for 15 eligible days by default; remain available and open to romance. Automatic invitation must be enabled.
Farm or Town in dry weather, or Saloon; 6 am–10 pm, when the location is accessible.
[b]F[/b][b]or Me?[/b]
Give Mina a bouquet after rebuilding at 8 hearts while available. Native dating must be confirmed.
Town or Saloon, 10 am–10 pm.

[b]After Closing[/b]
Dating at 10 hearts; finish Room at the Table or either invitation scene.
Saloon, 8–10 pm.

[b]A Good Ordinary Evening[/b]
At least seven days after The Picture We Keep; remain on the friendship route. No new heart threshold.
Saloon, 6–10 pm.

[b]A Key That Fits[/b]
Married to Mina for at least seven days, with 12 hearts.
Your own farmhouse or married cabin, 6 am–10 pm.

[b]Enough for Tonight[/b]
14 hearts, married; at least three days after A Key That Fits.
Your own farmhouse or married cabin, 6–10 pm.

[b]Lunch Is Not a Meeting[/b]
Finish the introduction; Mina has lived in town for at least fourteen days. If the argument happened, finish the apology.
Saloon, 10 am–10 pm.

[b]A Letter With No Reply[/b]
At least three days after A Fair Day’s Work.
Town in dry weather when Morris is available, 10 am–6 pm. Otherwise the Saloon letter version; it also becomes available after three days of waiting.

[b]A Better Forecast[/b]
Finish The Second Bowl.
Town on a rainy day, 10 am–10 pm.

[b]The Quiet Birthday[/b]
Meet Mina before her Fall 13 birthday. Not during the unresolved argument cooldown. A queued birthday can be delivered belatedly.
Saloon, noon–6 pm.[/spoiler]
[line]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1790536534-878225477.png[/img]
Three original songs play during Mina’s story and daily life. They use the game’s Music volume and can be switched off in her settings.
[list]
[*][b]Tea Leaves & Morning Dew[/b] — an occasional quiet visit to her annex or a moment outdoors.[/*]
[*][b]Happy Together[/b] — a 5% chance when waking up married to Mina. Marriage to another villager does not activate it.[/*]
[*][b]Can’t take it back[/b] — plays during her confrontation scene.[/*]
[/list][b]Ambient music chances:[/b]
[spoiler]Tea Leaves & Morning Dew defaults to a 10% chance on the first eligible annex entry, or a 1% quiet outdoor chance each day. At most one play is allowed per day across those two opportunities. Cutscenes, special weather, minigames and jukeboxes take priority. The ambient percentages are configurable.[/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1790536599-734155741.png[/img]
[b]Required: Stardew Valley + SMAPI.[/b] Tested with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2. SMAPI is the only required mod. Content Patcher and the optional integrations below are not needed for Mina to work.
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you don’t already have it.[/*]
[*]Close the game and back up your save. Download Mina’s release ZIP and extract it.[/*]
[*]Put the single [b]Mina Han[/b] folder directly inside [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b]. Keep its contents together.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. Visit Lewis’s manor once Mina has arrived.[/*]
[/list]For co-op, every player needs matching Mina files and a compatible setup for their other world and relationship mods.

[b]Updating or removing Mina[/b]
[spoiler]To update, close the game and back up both the save and old Mina folder. Keep your config.json, replace only Mina’s folder, then restore that config. Keep any removal backups separately. Do not leave two copies installed or mix old and new DLLs.

Before removing Mina from an ongoing farm, follow the included REMOVAL.md. Settle all relationships, leave her annex and use mina_prepare_removal from the single-player host. Follow its confirmation, sleep to save, then quit and remove the folder. Do not simply delete the folder while she is someone’s spouse.[/spoiler]
[line]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1790536671-1261667801.png[/img]
Mina works on her own with SMAPI. Optional support activates only when the relevant mods are present. Install those mods and their prerequisites separately.

[b]Reviewed optional versions and limits [/b]
[spoiler]Reviewed combinations include Stardew Valley Expanded 1.15.11, Ridgeside Village 2.5.17, East Scarp 3.0.9, Dating Reversed 5.6.0, Polyamory Sweet 1.6.1, Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0, Cloudy Skies 1.9.1 and Weather Wonders 1.5.3-beta.

This is a versioned compatibility record, not a guarantee about every collection or future release. Multiple partners are off by default and require the supported Polyamory components plus Mina’s explicit opt-in. Unknown Dating Reversed versions pause her automatic invitation rather than guessing at compatibility.[/spoiler]

Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. Without it, edit Mina’s config.json while the game is closed. Settings cover story scenes, new romance, the automatic invitation and its wait, umbrella or poncho, movement, reminder letters and original music.

For a bug report, include Mina’s version, a [url=https://smapi.io/log]full SMAPI log[/url], your optional mod versions, the location and date, and whether the farm is new or updated.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53030/53030-1790536787-659184016.png[/img]
The mod is currently in English. Translations use SMAPI’s i18n files, with English as the fallback for missing lines. Please feel free to translate to your hearts content :)

Mina Han is an independent fan mod.
